visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up comparison of two smartphones, the S25 Ultra and Pixel 10 Pro, side-by-side. They are held by hands and both screens display a zoomed-in, pixelated image of a Naruto figurine. The background is a blurred office/studio setting with shelves and decorative items. (2) The shot cuts to a medium shot of a young man with short black hair wearing a black and white horizontally striped shirt. He is standing in a modern office hallway, holding the two phones and looking at the camera. He points to the Pixel 10 Pro. (3) The camera returns to a close-up of the phones as they zoom in on the Naruto figurine. The Pixel screen shows a processing bar, and the image suddenly becomes sharp and detailed through AI enhancement. (4) A montage of side-by-side crops shows the Naruto figure's face as captured by the iPhone 16 Pro Max, S25 Ultra, and Pixel 10 Pro, highlighting the Pixel's clarity. (5) The phones are then used to zoom in on a small yellow figurine (Usagi) from a distance. The Pixel processes the image, but the result is a humorous, distorted human-like face on the rabbit body. (6) The man walks far down an office corridor. Another person holds the Pixel 10 Pro and zooms in 100x on the man's face. The screen shows a heavily pixelated face that then sharpens into a clear portrait through the 'Zoom Enhance' feature. (7) Final comparison shots show the man's face as seen on the Pixel 10 Pro and S25 Ultra side-by-side, with the Pixel image appearing more processed and smooth.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male voice explaining the 'calculation' process of a phone's zoom. High-tempo synth-pop BGM plays in the background. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a cut. (2) The narrator's speech rate is fast and enthusiastic as he describes the Pixel 10 Pro's 100x zoom. Laughter is heard off-camera. (3) A 'ding' sound effects occurs when the image on the phone screen snaps into focus. The narrator expresses amazement with rising intonation. (4) During the 'Usagi' figurine test, the two male voices joke around with comedic vocal inflections. A funny cartoon-style sound effect plays when the distorted AI face is revealed. (5) The final phase involves distant recording in an office hallway; the voices remain clear but have a slight room reverb. The BGM continues steadily until a final 'pop' SFX at the end.
